description: Active-work preserve list for cleanup controls. Add entries only while the named issues or PRs remain intentionally protected.
notes: Protected permanent branches (main/staging/development) are always preserved by cleanup-merged-branches.sh.
Open non-abandoned PRs already KEEP without this list; this list hard-preserves named active work even if evidence is mislabeled.
Live close/delete of external artifacts still requires MERGED or abandoned PR evidence (branches) or explicit --apply on file-backend completed repairs only.
